title: Dynamic golden strata and failure-mode driven promptset lifecycle
text:
Dynamic golden strata and failure-mode driven promptset lifecycle

description:
Problem: As config and model variants proliferate (quantization, kernel-level changes, routing fallbacks), one static golden set often misses emerging failure modes and creates noisy regression signals. We need a lifecycle for golden prompt sets that: (1) organizes examples into dynamic strata by failure mode and model sensitivity; (2) supports curated synthetic adversarial augmentation to surface brittle behaviors; (3) enforces stewarding, signer rotation and time-decay policies; and (4) ties automated re-eval gating to per-stratum thresholds rather than a single monolithic pass/fail. This ticket defines the product requirements, acceptance criteria, rollout plan, and governance for implementing dynamic golden strata and a failure-mode-driven promptset lifecycle.

acceptance_criteria:
Console: UI to browse golden strata and filter by failure-mode tags (e.g., hallucination, instruction-mismatch, tokenization-regressions) is available and accessible to stewards.
API/CLI: Endpoints to register a new golden stratum, attach examples, and add synthetic adversarial variants are implemented with ACL checks (steward role can create/edit; auditor read-only).
Eval automation: CI hook triggers staged re-eval per-stratum on config/model changes; thresholds are configurable per-stratum and stored with the stratum metadata.
Alerting: Slack/email alerts and Console banners for strata that breach severity thresholds; alerts include delta-versus-baseline and representative failing examples.
Governance: Signer rotation and immutability: each stratum snapshot MUST be signed and snapshot metadata contains signer and version; rotation procedure documented and validated through a test signer key swap.

rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (pilot): Create three pilot strata: hallucination, factuality-drifts, and truncation-edgecases. Onboard two stewards and run shadow re-evals against nightly runtime builds for 3 weeks.
Phase 2 (expanded): Open stratum creation to cross-functional stewards; add synthetic adversarial generator in the pipeline and enable alerting; require security review for signer keys.
Phase 3 (enforced): Block config/model rollout in CI when any stratum breaches a defined critical threshold unless an approved mitigation workflow is recorded in the rollout metadata.
Phase 4 (iterate): Expose per-customer visualization for Dedicated/Private customers who opt-in and provide RBAC hooks for custom strata.

migration_steps:
Inventory existing golden examples and tag them with preliminary failure-mode heuristics using heuristic classifier (script in repo) to seed strata.
Run historical re-evals to compute baseline metrics per-stratum and establish initial thresholds (alpha baselining job).
Create initial stratum snapshots and publish signed metadata; seed Console UI with these snapshots for steward review.
Update eval CI to run per-stratum comparisons and emit structured results to the Console and alerts channel.

monitoring_metrics:
per-stratum pass-rate and pass-rate-delta vs baseline
mean token-level logprob regression for failing examples
time-to-detection: latency between config/model change and first failing alert
false-positive rate of synthetic adversarial variants vs human-annotated failures
steward approval turnaround for new stratum snapshots

comments:
2026-02-11 — Lena Park: Draft PRD created and shared with reliability and research. Requested early feedback on failure-mode taxonomy.
2026-02-20 — Marcus Li: Engineering concurs with per-stratum CI gating but requests a fallback policy to avoid blocking unrelated regressions; suggested a severity tiering approach. Assigned ENG-51792 to implement fallback routing in CI.
2026-02-28 — Ana Gómez (Research): Ran preliminary synthetic adversarial generator on 4 models; observed that hallucination-stratum produced 3x signal uplift over baseline for our canary tests. Recommending additional human review to calibrate adversarial strength.
2026-03-05 — Security (R. Patel): KMS integration for signer keys required; flagged data residency implications for Private deployments. Security review kicked off.
2026-03-12 — Marcus Li: Pilot infra for per-stratum re-evals is live on nightly; first alert triggered (factuality stratum) and linked to PR #132 which introduced a kernel selection change. Investigating mitigation options.
